This full-bodied spirit is aged five years, first in American White Oak barrels then is finished in Tawny Port casks. SPECIFICATIONS FORMAT 750 mL MINIMUM MATURATION TIME 5 years ABV 49.75 (99.5 proof) MASH BILL Dark Pumpernickel Rye Non-GMO, Open Pollinated Yellow Corn 2-row Barley Ohio Soft Red Winter Wheat CASK TYPES Toasted and Charred American White Oak Tawny Port Casks
